definitions.explanation: The pressure of a sound wave in the air. In everyday audio talk, the perceived force or punch of a sound, especially of loud bass.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{音圧|おんあつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This track has high sound pressure.

examples.japanese: ⟦スピーカー→スピーカー：04420_supiikaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{音圧|おんあつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}する→調整する：10442_chouseisuru⟧。
examples.english: To adjust the sound pressure of the speakers.

examples.japanese: ⟦ライブ→ライブ：05412_raibu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{低音|ていおん}→低音：18282_teion⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{音圧|おんあつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{響|ひび}いた→響く：00099_hibiku⟧。
examples.english: At the live show, the sound pressure of the bass resonated through my body.

notes:
A term from acoustics for the pressure of a sound wave, but also used loosely by music and audio fans for how forceful or punchy a sound feels.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {音圧|おんあつ}⟦レベル→レベル：00352_reberu⟧: sound pressure level (SPL)
- {音圧|おんあつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: to have strong sound pressure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{音量|おんりょう}→音量：10009_onryou⟧: volume — the loudness setting or overall level
- ⟦{音響|おんきょう}→音響：16316_onkyou⟧: acoustics; sound — the broader field of how sound behaves
